Trump is back in the headlines—but this time, it’s not just controversy, it’s chaos. Threats, tariffs, ego-driven diplomacy, and open bullying of countries have become the norm. From trade wars to war threats, Trump’s style isn’t leadership—it’s intimidation.
In this video, we break down how Trump’s actions are destabilizing global politics. Why allies are nervous, why enemies are emboldened, and why countries like India can’t afford to ignore what’s coming next. This isn’t about left vs right—it’s about power, ego, and consequences.

What happens when the world’s most powerful man behaves like a loose cannon?Watch till the end for the full breakdown.
